definition_zh: 传票；出庭通知；（法院或官方的）传唤；召唤；召集令
definition_en: an official order telling someone to appear in court or before an authority; also a formal call to come
core_image: 一名信使快步走来，把一张盖着公章的纸递到你手里，你必须到场
scene: 开庭那天早上，警察把一张写着开庭日期的纸送到他手上。Early in the morning the police officer handed the businessman a court summons.
sceneCN: 这里 summons 是「传票」（第 1 个义项：法院命令某人到庭的文件）；句意：一大清早，警官把一张法院传票递给了那位商人。

pos.zh: 传票；出庭通知；召唤；召集令
传唤；召见；召集（第三人称单数形式）

derivatives.zh: 由名词去掉词尾 s 得到动词，义为「召唤；传唤；鼓起（勇气）」
动词加 -ing 构成动名词，义为「签发或送达传票」
动词加后缀 -er 构成，义为「召唤者；传唤人」

senses.title: A court order to appear
senses.definition: a written official order requiring a person to appear in court on a particular day
senses.definitionCN: 法院签发的书面正式命令，要求某人在指定日期出庭
senses.example: The witness received a summons to give evidence next month.
senses.exampleCN: 证人收到一份传票，要求他下个月出庭作证。
senses.why: The medieval Latin phrase a summons, meaning a calling to court, was taken into English as one word, so the noun keeps the sense of a legal call that must be obeyed.
senses.whyCN: 中古拉丁语中的「传唤到法庭」这一说法被英语整体吸收为一个词，因此这个名词保留了「必须服从的法律召唤」这一含义。

senses.title: A formal call to come
senses.definition: an official or formal request for someone to come to a place or a person
senses.definitionCN: 正式或官方要求某人前来的召唤
senses.example: The king sent a summons to the duke, who rode to court at once.
senses.exampleCN: 国王向公爵发出召见令，公爵立刻骑马赶往宫廷。
senses.why: The old law French verb summons means to call upon, so the noun can still mean any solemn call to come, in law or at court.
senses.whyCN: 古法语法律用语 summons 意为「召唤」，所以这个词名词化后仍可泛指任何庄重的召唤，法律场合与宫廷场合都适用。

senses.title: A call for people to gather
senses.definition: an urgent word or signal that calls a group of people to come together
senses.definitionCN: 召集一群人聚集的紧急通知、命令或信号
senses.example: The town crier read out a summons for all citizens to meet in the square.
senses.exampleCN: 镇上的公告员宣读召集令，让全体市民到广场集合。
senses.why: Calling one person and calling many use the same verb, so the same word widened from a single person to the whole assembly.
senses.whyCN: 召唤一个人与召唤一群人用的是同一个动词，于是这个词从单人扩大了整个集会。

senses.title: The act of being commanded
senses.definition: the demand itself, as something a person has to answer or obey
senses.definitionCN: 这项要求本身，指某人不得不回应或服从的召唤
senses.example: She could not ignore the summons from the court.
senses.exampleCN: 她无法无视法院的传唤。
senses.why: Once the call is made, it is felt as an obligation, so the noun shifts from the paper to the pressure it places on the addressee.
senses.whyCN: 召唤一旦发出，就变成了被召唤者的义务，于是名词从那张纸转移到它施加给收件人的压力上。

senses.title: An official notice to do something
senses.definition: a demand by an authority that a person come to a place or carry out a duty
senses.definitionCN: 权威机构要求某人前往某地或履行某项职责的通告
senses.example: The committee sent a summons to the owner of the unsafe building.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会向那栋危楼的业主发出了责令通知。
senses.why: Courts, councils and committees all use the same formal call, so the word spreads from court filings to administrative demands.
senses.whyCN: 法院、市政会和委员会都用同一种正式召唤，因此这个词从法院文书扩展到行政层面的要求。

intro.en: Summons began as a Latin phrase and became a single noun through Old French legal language.
intro.cn: summons 起源于一个拉丁语短语，经由古法语的法律用语变成一个独立的英语名词。

items.en: Sub and monere combine to mean to remind or give a hint.
items.cn: sub（在下面）与 monere（提醒）合起来表示提醒、提示。

items.en: A summons is the genitive of summonitio, meaning a calling to court.
items.cn: 在中古拉丁语中，a summons 是 summonitio（传唤到庭）的属格短语。

items.en: Law French summons means to call upon, a verb and a noun used in the courts.
items.cn: 法律法语 summons 意为召唤，在法庭中兼具动词与名词用法。

items.en: The phrase is taken into English as the single noun summons.
items.cn: 这个短语整体被英语吸收，成为单一的名词 summons。

items.en: The plural summonses develops, and the verb to summon wins over summons as a verb.
items.cn: 复数形式 summonses 逐步确立，动词用法则由 summon 取代 summons。

items.en: The noun keeps its legal force but also keeps the wider sense of a call to come.
items.cn: 现代英语中它保留法律效力，同时保留泛指「召唤」的含义。

note.en: Summons is the formal call, close to the legal package and to ordinary calling words.
note.cn: summons 是正式的召唤，与法律文书一族以及普通的「叫」类词相邻。

entries.definition: to order someone to appear, or to gather your courage
entries.definitionCN: 传唤；召唤；鼓起（勇气）

entries.definition: more than one court order to appear
entries.definitionCN: 复数形式，多份传票

entries.definition: a person or device that warns or keeps watch
entries.definitionCN: 监视者；显示器（与 monere 同源）

entries.definition: a legal order requiring a witness to appear or produce documents
entries.definitionCN: 传票；要求证人出庭或提交证据的法律命令

entries.definition: an official notice that commands someone to appear in court
entries.definitionCN: 传讯；出庭通知

entries.definition: a loud request or invitation for someone to come
entries.definitionCN: 呼唤；叫喊（最一般的召唤）

normalIntro.en: Summons is the formal call of sub and monere: a reminder sent from above that will not go away.
normalIntro.cn: summons 是 sub 与 monere 的正式召唤：一个从上面发下来、躲不掉的提醒。

normal.en: Think of summon with an s at the end: the verb summons you, and the paper that does it is a summons.
normal.cn: 记住 summon 加一个 s：动词 summon 召唤你，做这件事的那张纸就是 summons。

normal.en: Monere means to warn, so a summons is a warning you must answer.
normal.cn: monere 意为警告，所以 summons 是一个必须回应的警告。

normal.en: The plural is summonses, with an extra s and es, never summons alone.
normal.cn: 复数写作 summonses，要再加 s 与 es，不能直接用 summons。

normal.en: In law, a summons tells you where to be and when, without asking whether you would like to come.
normal.cn: 在法律中，传票只告诉你何时何地到场，不会问你想不想来。

normal.en: To summon up courage uses the same root: you call all your courage to stand beside you.
normal.cn: summon up courage 用同一个词根：你把所有勇气都召唤到身边。

abstract.en: Picture a messenger at the door, holding one stamped sheet and refusing to leave.
abstract.cn: 想象一名信使站在门口，手里只拿一张盖了章的纸，怎么也不肯走。

abstract.en: Picture a trumpet call across the castle yard, and every door opening at once.
abstract.cn: 想象号角声传遍城堡院落，所有房门同时打开。

abstract.en: Picture the town crier on the steps, reading a list of names aloud to the crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象公告员站在台阶上，向人群大声念出一串名字。

examples.en: He was served with a summons for failing to pay the fine.
examples.cn: 他因未缴纳罚款而被送达了传票。

examples.en: The council issued a summons ordering the owner to repair the roof.
examples.cn: 市政会发出通知，责令业主修缮屋顶。

examples.en: Ignoring the summons made the fine much larger.
examples.cn: 无视传唤让罚款变得高了很多。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「撒门子」——公文撒到门下，你就得开门到场；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 sub-（在下面）+ monere（提醒、警告，同源词 monitor、admonish）→ 中古拉丁语 a summons（传唤到庭）→ 法律法语 summons → 英语 summons，核心义「正式的召唤」。

sensesIntro.en: Summons moves from the legal paper to any solemn call, and then to a call that gathers a group.
sensesIntro.cn: summons 从法律文书出发，扩展到任何庄重的召唤，再扩展到召集一群人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a messenger delivering one stamped sheet you must answer.
core.cn: 核心意象：信使送来一张盖了章、你必须回应的纸。

branches.en: The court order is the most concrete and most frequent sense.
branches.cn: 法院的书面命令是最具体、最常见的义项。

branches.en: A formal call and the obligation to answer it form one pair.
branches.cn: 正式召唤与被召唤者的义务构成一对。

branches.en: Calling many people turns the word into a call to assemble.
branches.cn: 召唤许多人时，这个词就变成集结的通知。

branches.en: Non-judicial authorities use it for official demands.
branches.cn: 非司法机关也用这个词表示官方的责令。

branches.en: Both senses share the stamped sheet and the refusal to be ignored.
branches.cn: 这两个义项都共享「盖章的纸」和「不可无视」的特征。

intro.en: Summons is built from the prefix sub- and the root mon, with the English verb summon and its family around it.
intro.cn: summons 由前缀 sub- 与词根 mon 构成，周围是英语动词 summon 及其词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin monere means to remind or warn, and summonere means to remind privately or call up.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 monere 意为提醒、警告，summonere 意为私下提醒或召唤。

items.example: The prefix sub- hides inside summon.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 sub- 藏在 summon 这个词里。

items.example: The root mon- gives the warning idea.
items.exampleCN: 词根 mon- 提供「警告」的含义。

items.example: Monere is the source of many English words.
items.exampleCN: monere 是许多英语词的来源。

items.meaning: to call up, to remind privately
items.example: Summonere is formed with sub and monere.
items.exampleCN: summonere 由 sub 与 monere 组合而成。

items.meaning: to order to appear, to gather
items.example: Summon is the everyday English verb.
items.exampleCN: summon 是日常使用的英语动词。

items.example: Summons keeps the legal noun sense.
items.exampleCN: summons 保留法律名词含义。

items.example: Admonish adds a prefix to the same root.
items.exampleCN: admonish 在同一词根前加了前缀。

items.example: Monitor keeps the warning meaning.
items.exampleCN: monitor 保留了「警告」的含义。

items.example: The ending -s marks the Latin phrase.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -s 是拉丁短语的痕迹。

items.example: The plural summonses adds es to the noun.
items.exampleCN: 复数 summonses 在名词后加 es。

definition_zh: 日晷；日规
definition_en: an ancient device that shows the time of day by the shadow that the sun casts on a marked dial
core_image: 花园里一块刻着刻度的石盘，中央竖着一根细棍，影子随太阳慢慢爬动
scene: 午后，花园里的石盘上，一根细棍的影子慢慢从刻度一侧移到另一侧。In the afternoon, the shadow of the rod crept across the old sundial in the garden.
sceneCN: 这里 sundial 是「日晷」（第 1 个义项：靠太阳影子指示时间的仪器）；句意：午后，花园里那座旧日晷上，细棍的影子慢慢爬过。

collocations.phrase: read the time from a sundial
a stone sundial in the garden

derivatives.zh: 由第二个成分独立成词，义为「表盘；刻度盘」
复合词项由 sundial 与 list 叠加构成，指「日晷刻度表」一类清单，较少用
第一个构词成分，义为「太阳」

senses.title: A shadow clock with a marked dial
senses.definition: an instrument that tells the time of day by the position of a shadow cast by the sun on a dial marked with hours
senses.definitionCN: 一种靠太阳投在刻度盘上的影子位置来指示时刻的仪器
senses.example: The sundial in the school garden showed almost noon.
senses.exampleCN: 学校花园里的日晷显示出快到正午了。
senses.why: The word joins sun and dial, so it names a dial that belongs to the sun rather than to wheels and springs.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由 sun（太阳）与 dial（刻度盘）合成，指的是属于太阳的刻度盘，而不是靠齿轮和发条的表。

senses.title: The dial stone itself
senses.definition: the flat plate or stone bearing the hour lines on which the shadow falls
senses.definitionCN: 刻有时刻线、供影子落在其上的平板或石板
senses.example: An old stone sundial still stood among the roses.
senses.exampleCN: 玫瑰花丛中仍立着一块古老的石制日晷。
senses.why: Since the plate is the most visible part, the whole name shifts onto the object a visitor can touch.
senses.whyCN: 由于石板是最显眼的部分，整个词就转移到游客能摸到的那件实物上。

senses.title: A general term for old timekeepers
senses.definition: any early device for telling time by the apparent movement of the sun
senses.definitionCN: 泛指任何依靠太阳视运动计时的早期计时装置
senses.example: Museums show sundials beside water clocks and sand glasses.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆把日晷与水钟、沙漏摆在一起展出。
senses.why: Because it is a compound of two simple nouns, it serves as the everyday label for the whole class of sun clocks.
senses.whyCN: 因为它由两个简单名词合成，就顺理成章地成为「太阳钟」这类装置的日常统称。

senses.title: A small garden ornament
senses.definition: a decorative reproduction of a sundial used to ornament a lawn or patio
senses.definitionCN: 草坪或露台上装饰用的日晷仿制品
senses.example: They bought a brass sundial for the patio, more for looks than for time.
senses.exampleCN: 他们买了一座黄铜日晷放在露台上，更多是为了好看，而非看时间。
senses.why: When people no longer need the instrument for time, its shape survives as a symbol of gardens and summer.
senses.whyCN: 当人们不再靠它看时间，它的外形就作为花园与夏日的象征留存下来。

senses.title: A figure for slowly passing time
senses.definition: a symbol or image of unhurried, sunny days that pass little by little
senses.definitionCN: 象征悠长晴日、时光一点点流逝的意象
senses.example: The sundial on the cover invited a slower pace of life.
senses.exampleCN: 封面上的日晷让人联想到更慢的生活节奏。
senses.why: Its shadow moves so slowly that the object itself comes to stand for patience and the passing of days.
senses.whyCN: 它的影子移动得极慢，于是这件器物本身就象征着耐心与日子流逝。

intro.en: Sundial is a native English compound that names a sun dial beside the older dial of the church.
intro.cn: sundial 是英语本土的复合词，用「太阳的刻度盘」来区别于教堂里的旧 dial。

items.en: Sun and dial both exist as separate words, dial first meaning a day or a clock.
items.cn: sun 与 dial 在古英语中都是独立的词，dial 最初表示「一天」或「钟」。

items.en: Dial settles on a marked face for showing hours, the round plate of a clock.
items.cn: 在中古英语中，dial 固定为标示时刻的刻度面，即钟表的圆形盘面。

items.en: The compound sun dial appears to separate the sun clock from the church dial.
items.cn: 十六世纪左右出现复合词 sun dial，用来把太阳钟与教堂用的刻度盘区分开。

items.en: The joined spelling sundial spreads in gardening and mathematics books.
items.cn: 十七世纪时连写的 sundial 在园艺与数学书籍中流行开来。

items.en: The word keeps both the instrument sense and the decorative garden sense.
items.cn: 现代英语中它同时保留仪器义与花园装饰义。

note.en: Sundial names an old way of reading the sun, close to its compound parts and to other timekeepers.
note.cn: sundial 指一种读太阳的古老方式，与它的构词成分以及其它计时器相邻。

entries.definition: the marked face of a clock or other instrument
entries.definitionCN: 钟表的表盘；刻度面

entries.definition: a written table of the hour lines used for a sundial
entries.definitionCN: 供制作日晷使用的时刻线表格

entries.definition: the first day of the week, from the day of the sun
entries.definitionCN: 星期日，源于「太阳日」，只是拼写相近，词源不同，与日晷无关

entries.definition: the rod or edge of a sundial that casts the shadow
entries.definitionCN: 晷针；日晷上投下影子的立杆

entries.definition: a glass device that measures time by running sand
entries.definitionCN: 沙漏

entries.definition: a machine that measures and shows the time
entries.definitionCN: 钟；时钟

normalIntro.en: Sundial is simply sun plus dial: the dial that runs on sunlight.
normalIntro.cn: sundial 就是 sun 加 dial：靠阳光运转的刻度盘。

normal.en: Take sun and dial apart: the sun gives light, the dial gives the numbers.
normal.cn: 把 sun 与 dial 拆开：太阳提供光，刻度盘提供数字。

normal.en: The old church dial showed hours, and the sun dial did the same job outdoors.
normal.cn: 教堂旧式的 dial 显示时辰，太阳版 dial 在户外做同样的工作。

normal.en: A sundial needs no battery and no spring, only a shadow and a line.
normal.cn: 日晷不需要电池也不需要发条，只要影子和一条线。

normal.en: Say it aloud: sun and dial run together as sundial, with the stress on sun.
normal.cn: 大声读一遍：sun 与 dial 连读成 sundial，重音落在 sun 上。

normal.en: Its shadow only means something where the sun actually shines.
normal.cn: 只有在阳光真正照到的地方，它的影子才有意义。

abstract.en: Picture a thin rod in the middle of a stone plate, its shadow creeping like a slow hand.
abstract.cn: 想象石盘中间立着一根细杆，影子像一只极慢的指针在爬。

abstract.en: Picture the flat engraved stone where the shadow lands, warm from the sun.
abstract.cn: 想象影子落下的那块刻着线、被晒得温热的石板。

abstract.en: Picture a museum shelf where a sundial, a water clock and an hourglass line up.
abstract.cn: 想象博物馆的架子上，日晷、水钟和沙漏排成一排。

examples.en: In summer the sundial on the lawn was more accurate than any watch.
examples.cn: 夏天里，草坪上的日晷比任何手表都准。

examples.en: The sundials in old gardens were often made of brass and stone.
examples.cn: 旧时花园里的日晷常用黄铜和石头制成。

examples.en: Gardeners love sundials because they decorate a bed as well as mark the time.
examples.cn: 园丁喜欢日晷，因为它们既装点花坛，又能标示时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「散呆儿」——太阳斜着散开，影子一点一点呆慢地挪；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 英语 sun（太阳，古英语 sunne）+ dial（刻度盘，古英语 dial 原指「一天、钟」），复合指「靠太阳的刻度盘」，即日晷。

sensesIntro.en: Sundial starts as the instrument, then names its stone plate, its whole old class, and finally a garden ornament and a symbol of slow time.
sensesIntro.cn: sundial 先从仪器说起，再指它的石板，然后泛指整类古计时器，最后引申为花园摆件与慢时光的象征。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rod shadow creeping over a stone dial in the sun.
core.cn: 核心意象：日光下，杆影在石盘刻度上缓缓爬行。

branches.en: The instrument for reading the time is the core sense.
branches.cn: 用来读时间的仪器是核心义项。

branches.en: The stone plate is the part people touch and decorate.
branches.cn: 石板是被人触摸与装点的那一部分。

branches.en: As a simple compound it labels the whole class of early clocks.
branches.cn: 作为简单的复合词，它统称整类早期计时器。

branches.en: The ornament and the symbol of slow days grow from the object staying in gardens.
branches.cn: 装饰义与慢时光象征义源于这件器物留在花园里。

branches.en: Both rely on the sun instead of springs or sand.
branches.cn: 两者都靠太阳而不是靠发条或沙子。

intro.en: Sundial is a transparent English compound, with sun and dial as living parts rather than Latin affixes.
intro.cn: sundial 是透明的英语复合词，sun 与 dial 都是活的构词成分，而非拉丁词缀。

latinIntro.en: Dial comes from Latin dies, a day, through a dial face that once showed the hours of a day.
latinIntro.cn: dial 经由曾标示一日时辰的表盘，来自拉丁语 dies（一天）。

items.example: Sun names the light that makes the shadow.
items.exampleCN: sun 指明制造影子的光。

items.example: Dial gives the clock face.
items.exampleCN: dial 提供表盘。

items.example: Dies is behind the word dial.
items.exampleCN: dies 是 dial 背后的拉丁词。

items.example: Diurnus means belonging to the day.
items.exampleCN: diurnus 意为属于白天的。

items.example: Sundial joins the two parts with a simple blend.
items.exampleCN: sundial 把两个成分直接拼合。

items.example: The ending -s forms sundials.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -s 构成复数 sundials。

items.meaning: one who knows, the shadow caster
items.example: A gnomon stands at the centre of a dial.
items.exampleCN: 晷针立在刻度盘中央。

items.example: A sundial marks the hours on its lines.
items.exampleCN: 日晷用刻线标出时辰。

items.example: Old clocks worked without any sunlight.
items.exampleCN: 旧式钟表不靠日光运转。
